changed_text_dependencies.value: 稳妥版可以说：While your proposal would certainly be ideal, I'm afraid we haven't found a way to shave two weeks off the schedule without additional cost, so we'd prefer to keep the original schedule.
稳妥版可以说：While your proposal would certainly be ideal, I'm afraid we haven't found a way to shave two weeks off the schedule without additional cost, so we'd prefer to keep the original schedule.
“certainly be ideal”保留客气里的一点距离；“haven't found a way to shave two weeks off the schedule”明确是压缩工期，也带有轻微无奈和修辞距离；结尾把拒绝落稳。多数商务听者会觉得坚定，但不至于有攻击性。
